1.zh: 为基督耶稣被囚的保罗，同兄弟提摩太写信给我们所亲爱的同工腓利门，
1.en: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

1.zh: 和妹子亚腓亚并与我们同当兵的亚基布，以及在你家的教会。
1.en: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

1.zh: 愿恩惠、平安从　神我们的父和主耶稣基督归与你们！
1.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 我祷告的时候提到你，常为你感谢我的　神；
1.en: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

1.zh: 因听说你的爱心并你向主耶稣和众圣徒的信心。
1.en: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

1.zh: 愿你与人所同有的信心显出功效，使人知道你们各样善事都是为基督做的。
1.en: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

1.zh: 兄弟啊，我为你的爱心，大有快乐，大得安慰，因众圣徒的心从你得了畅快。
1.en: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

1.zh: 我虽然靠着基督能放胆吩咐你合宜的事，
1.en: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

1.zh: 然而像我这有年纪的保罗，现在又是为基督耶稣被囚的，宁可凭着爱心求你，
1.en: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 就是为我在捆锁中所生的儿子阿尼西谋求你。
1.en: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

1.zh: 他从前与你没有益处，但如今与你我都有益处。
1.en: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

1.zh: 我现在打发他亲自回你那里去；他是我心上的人。
1.en: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

1.zh: 我本来有意将他留下，在我为福音所受的捆锁中替你伺候我。
1.en: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

1.zh: 但不知道你的意思，我就不愿意这样行，叫你的善行不是出于勉强，乃是出于甘心。
1.en: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

1.zh: 他暂时离开你，或者是叫你永远得着他，
1.en: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

1.zh: 不再是奴仆，乃是高过奴仆，是亲爱的兄弟。在我实在是如此，何况在你呢！这也不拘是按肉体说，是按主说。
1.en: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

1.zh: 你若以我为同伴，就收纳他，如同收纳我一样。
1.en: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

1.zh: 他若亏负你，或欠你什么，都归在我的帐上；
1.en: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

1.zh: 我必偿还，这是我—保罗亲笔写的。我并不用对你说，连你自己也是亏欠于我。
1.en: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

1.zh: 兄弟啊，望你使我在主里因你得快乐，并望你使我的心在基督里得畅快。
1.en: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

1.zh: 我写信给你，深信你必顺服，知道你所要行的必过于我所说的。
1.en: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

1.zh: 此外你还要给我预备住处；因为我盼望借着你们的祷告，必蒙恩到你们那里去。
1.en: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

1.zh: 为基督耶稣与我同坐监的以巴弗问你安。
1.en: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

1.zh: 与我同工的马可、亚里达古、底马、路加也都问你安。
1.en: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

1.zh: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩[常]在你的心里。阿们！
1.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
